_comment: Weights for Tools/_SW/ci_shard.py, in seconds of CI run time (2-core, 8 GB private-repo runner). Classes not listed weigh seconds_per_test per [Test]/[TestCase] plus seconds_per_case_source per [TestCaseSource]. Calibrated 2026-11-04 from run 41827585917 (PostMapInitTest alone 6.5 min, GlobalWarEconomyLongRunTest alone 8.5 min, GlobalWarRespawnTest shard 2.3 min, 176 small tests 7.5 min) and a local TRX of the GlobalWar classes times 2.2 (CI/local ratio of the same shard). The CI log prints every test with its time; refine from it. Classes in 'heavy' go to different bins first.
